strategy.name: TSLL Seconds Passive Limit Scalper
strategy.description: Buy TSLL 3 cents below the prior completed 1-second close, target +3 cents, stop 5 cents, and exit after 10 seconds.

assumptions.data: Massive REST 1-second TSLL aggregates expanded to OHLCV bars plus 1-minute SPY/QQQ/TSLA/TSLL market context.
assumptions.caveat: Seconds bars show traded prices, not actual bid/ask queue priority; validate with quote data before live use.
